data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for WhatsApp, Google Meet, and Teams-style VoIP call UI and native notifications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a plug-and-play call UI and VoIP workflow for WebRTC video and audio calls. Handles native full-screen incoming call intents on Android, CallKit on iOS, ongoing-call notifications, and conference layouts.
use_when: You are building audio or video calls with WebRTC and need native WhatsApp-style incoming/outgoing call UX.
You need integration with Android full-screen intents and iOS CallKit out of the box.
avoid_when: Your app does not implement voice or video calls.
You require custom native incoming call UI on iOS (iOS uses system CallKit UI).
strengths: Plug-and-play UI for 1-to-1 and multi-participant conference calls.
Cold-start ready with event buffering and startup route resolution from push notifications.
Works with any WebRTC backend via CallwaveEngine implementation.
weaknesses: Requires specific native configuration on Android and iOS.
High platform coupling for VoIP-specific intents and native call integrations.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android API 26+ and iOS 13+. Needs host Activity intent actions on Android, CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager on iOS, and implementation of CallwaveEngine callbacks.
